criterion: Audit log answers 'what did my agent do?'
description: Action names don't match user actions: moving a file to Trash is logged as 'drive.delete', opening the Trash tab is logged as 'drive.trash', and some rows show 'unknown'. Every console page load adds 5-6 list entries, burying meaningful events. There is no filter by actor or action.
expected: Human-readable labels (e.g. 'Moved /tests/sample.bin to Trash'), read-only list calls hidden or collapsed, and a filter by agent/action.
actual: Raw route names, misleading labels, list noise, no filter.
suggested_fix: Fix the action-name mapping for trash/list-trash and unknown routes, hide list reads by default, add actor/action filters.
